audit.whatIsWrong: Content win[] and the full-layer phases both read Skill / Pantheon / Pantheon / Skill / Skill / Pantheon / Pantheon. The packet levelChart reads Pantheon / Pantheon / Skill / Graves / Graves / Graves / Skill. Six of seven rows are wrong, in both layers, and Graves is credited with no stage at all in a lane he wins 51.85% of.
audit.why: The content whys describe the packet order exactly and contradict the enums printed beside them: whys[0] 'bullies your level 1' (Pantheon), whys[2] 'so it's a coin-flip skirmish' (Skill), whys[3] 'you out-sustain his front-loaded poke' (Graves), whys[4] 'his level-6 R is a global roam tool, not a 1v1 power spike' (Graves), whys[5] 'peak duel power and Pantheon is already starting to fall off' (Graves), whys[6] 'even on paper' (Skill). The chart tells the player he loses a lane the prose tells him he wins.
audit.corrected: Both charts set to Pantheon / Pantheon / Skill / Graves / Graves / Graves / Skill, ratings 3,3,5,7,7,7,5 from the Graves side. EVEN at 5.5/10 stays — 51.85% over 27 games supports it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's phases are generic and never name a Pantheon ability; the spike shape is inverted, with the first item marked as a Pantheon stage.
audit.why: This lane's real shape is front-loaded: Pantheon owns Levels 1-2 on a point-and-click Shield Vault (13/12/11/10/9s) into Comet Spear, it evens at 3, and from Levels 4-5 onward Graves compounds — True Grit stacking while every landed basic attack shortens Quickdraw's 16s. Grand Starfall at 180s rank 1 is a map tool, not a duel spike, so Level 6 favours Graves. That timeline is in the content layer and absent from the full layer.
audit.corrected: phases[0]-[6] rewritten with the real ability names and cooldowns and the spike order corrected.
sources: ownerKit E cd 16/15/14/13/12 and Riot text

audit.whatIsWrong: Pantheon's E is called 'his Aegis passive' in whys[1], whys[2], content mid, content late and wants.foe[1]. His passive is Mortal Will; Aegis Assault is the E.
audit.why: Riot: passive Mortal Will — 'Every few spells or attacks, Pantheon's next spell is empowered.' E Aegis Assault — 'Pantheon sets his shield, becoming invulnerable to damage from the front and striking repeatedly with his spear', 22/21/20/19/18s. Treating it as a passive tells the player it is always on and cannot be played around, when it is in fact the longest cooldown in Pantheon's kit and directional. That directionality is the decisive interaction of the matchup for a champion whose damage is four bullets fired in a line, and it appears nowhere.
audit.corrected: Named Aegis Assault (E) throughout; the front-only invulnerability and the 22-second cooldown stated so the player circles the shield instead of feeding it.
sources: enemyKit P and E Riot text and cooldowns

audit.whatIsWrong: Smoke Screen is described as a blind in whys[2], spikes[1].text, content early (twice), content mid, content late, wants.you[1], phases[6].why and report[10].t.
audit.why: Riot: 'creating a cloud of smoke that reduces sight range. Enemies caught in the initial impact are dealt magic damage and have their Move Speed reduced briefly.' Nearsight plus impact slow, no blind. The mirror audit on pantheon__graves records the same correction from Pantheon's side and notes the page 'was talking you out of trades you were still winning' — here the error runs the other way, promising a blind that would shut off his empowered autos and does not.
audit.corrected: Smoke Screen slows on impact and reduces sight range; it stops none of his abilities or attacks.
sources: ownerKit W Riot text and flags

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states that Graves' four bullets cannot pass through units, and nothing states that landed basic attacks shorten Quickdraw.
audit.why: Both are in Riot's text — passive: 'Attacks fire 4 bullets, which cannot pass through units'; E: 'Hitting enemies with basic attacks lowers the cooldown of this skill and refreshes the resistance boost.' The mirror audit lists both from Pantheon's side as the things he plays around, so Graves' page must state them from his side: minions eat the volley, and the autos you land are what buys the dash back.
audit.corrected: The Quickdraw cooldown-reduction is stated in phases[3].why. The minion-block is recorded here; the mirror already carries it from Pantheon's side.
sources: ownerKit P and E Riot text

audit.whatIsWrong: Shield Vault is named the matchup clock in six fields without its cooldown.
audit.why: 13/12/11/10/9s. 'Thirteen seconds with no point-click stun' is the actual green light the page keeps gesturing at.
audit.corrected: Number added to dosFull[2].d, phases[1].why and content mid.

edits.before: Pantheon's level 1-2 is the scary part — his W is a point-click dash-stun he doesn't have to aim, and he chains it into a Comet Spear to burst you before you have any E charges to dash away, and your 4-shell magazine forces awkward reloads if you trade back blind. Don't walk into his W range to last-hit early; soak a little spear poke and farm with the tip of End of the Line. Once you hit level 3 with Q, W and E, the lane flips: E in for the point-blank shell spread, drop your W cloud on him so the blind shuts off his passive-empowered autos, and your sustained burst beats his poke. Note the blind does NOT stop his Q spear or W stun — those are abilities — so it only denies his auto-attack damage in a brawl.
edits.after: Pantheon's level 1-2 is the scary part — his W is a point-click dash-stun he doesn't have to aim, and he chains it into a Comet Spear to burst you before you have any E charges to dash away, and your 4-shell magazine forces awkward reloads if you trade back into it. Don't walk into his 600-range W to last-hit early; soak a little spear poke and farm with the tip of End of the Line. Once you hit level 3 with Q, W and E, the lane flips: E in for the point-blank shell spread, drop your W cloud on him for the impact slow and the vision cut, and your sustained burst beats his poke. Note Smoke Screen is not a blind — it reduces sight range and slows, so it stops nothing of his; and Aegis Assault (E) makes him invulnerable to damage from the FRONT, so every shell fired into the shield is wasted.

edits.before: This is your window. With E charges refreshing off your autos and True Grit armor/MR compounding, you out-trade Pantheon in any extended fight — bait his W stun, eat it, then E-W-Q while it's on cooldown and his Aegis passive isn't enough to save him from the point-blank spread. At 6 your Collateral Damage turns an even skirmish into a kill, while his R is a global roam rather than a dueling buff. Still respect his point-click W: he can stun-start his own all-in, so don't commit into a fresh W — make him use it on a trade first, then drop your smoke to blind his autos and out-DPS him through the brawl.

edits.before: Once you hit Eclipse you're at peak duel power and Pantheon is fading hard — his kit is front-loaded for levels 1-6 and falls off into items, so the longer the lane goes the more it tilts your way. Keep forcing the all-in on your item timer; he can't out-stat your stacked True Grit armor and MR anymore, and his Aegis passive only buys him a couple of blocked autos. Just respect his global Grand Starfall roams to other lanes — that's where a fed Pantheon does his real damage — and keep W ready to blind his autos and cut his vision when you skirmish.

notes: Worst level chart of my slice: six of seven rows wrong in BOTH layers, and in the same direction — Graves was given no winning stage at all in a lane he wins 51.85% of, while the content whys sitting right beside the chart described the packet order correctly. Proposed as one atomic group per layer. Second real error: Pantheon's E is called 'his Aegis passive' in five fields. Aegis Assault is the E, 22/21/20/19/18s, and Riot's text says he becomes 'invulnerable to damage from the FRONT'. That directionality is the single most important interaction in the matchup for a champion who fires four bullets in a line, and calling it a passive told the player it was permanent and unplayable-around. His actual passive is Mortal Will. Smoke Screen was called a blind in nine places here — the largest count in my slice — including an instruction to use it to shut off his empowered autos, which does not work. Aligned with the already-audited mirror (pantheon__graves), which independently corrected the same Smoke Screen error and supplied the two Graves facts I restated from this side: the four bullets cannot pass through units, and every landed basic attack shortens Quickdraw's 16-second cooldown.
